info.name: Final Buzzer: the public checks
info.description: Runs against the live site. Every request is read-only or refused: nothing here pays, scores or re-plans. What it asserts: the board and the scorer's page are up; the tournament document holds 88 games; the rate card is $45 a referee and $25 a table official and says it is provisional; every successful payout in the ledger carries a PayPal batch id and a completion time, every amount is on the rate card, and the agent's run (what it asked for, when it chose) is kept with the record; the agent is on duty; the daily cap holds; every webhook in the public log was signature-verified (one that fails the check is rejected and kept out of it); Sam's taps and closing a gym are refused without the treasurer's PIN, and the held game stays held.

exec: pm.test('88 games over 4 days', () => { pm.expect(games.length).to.eql(88); pm.expect(new Set(games.map((g) => g.start.slice(0, 10))).size).to.eql(4); });

pm.test('every game has an id, a start and a status', () => games.forEach((g) => { pm.expect(g.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(g.start).to.match(/^2026-05-1[4-7]T/); pm.expect(['scheduled', 'final', 'forfeit']).to.include(g.status); }));
pm.test('$45 a referee, $25 a table official', () => { pm.expect(c.per_game.referee).to.eql(45); pm.expect(c.per_game.table).to.eql(25); });
pm.test('the card says it is provisional', () => pm.expect(c.provisional).to.eql(true));

item.name: The ledger: every payout confirmed by PayPal, every amount on the card

exec: pm.test('at least Saturday\'s 28 games paid', () => pm.expect(ok.length).to.be.at.least(28));

pm.test('every successful payout carries a PayPal batch id and a completion time', () => ok.forEach((p) => { pm.expect(p.batchId, p.senderBatchId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(p.completedAt, p.senderBatchId).to.be.a('string'); }));
pm.test('every amount is a rate card figure', () => ok.forEach((p) => p.items.forEach((i) => pm.expect([45, 25], p.senderBatchId).to.include(Number(i.amount)))));
const agent = ok.filter((p) => p.decidedBy === 'agent' && p.secondsFromBuzzer != null);

pm.test('the agent\'s payouts land within a minute of the buzzer (median)', () => { const s = agent.map((p) => p.secondsFromBuzzer).sort((a, b) => a - b); pm.expect(s.length).to.be.at.least(28); pm.expect(s[s.length >> 1]).to.be.below(60); });

pm.test('the agent\'s run is kept with its payouts: what it asked for, when it chose', () => { const withRun = agent.filter((p) => p.agent && p.agent.steps && p.agent.steps.some((s) => s.name === 'decide')); pm.expect(withRun.length).to.be.at.least(30); withRun.forEach((p) => pm.expect(p.agent.steps.map((s) => s.name)).to.include.members(['read_game_sheet', 'read_rate_card', 'check_paypal_for_game'])); });

pm.test('every hold names a reason and who held it', () => Object.values(l.holds).forEach((h) => { pm.expect(h.reason).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(['agent', 'guard', 'paypal']).to.include(h.by); }));
pm.test('game 17 is held: PayPal already showed it paid', () => { pm.expect(l.holds.g053).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(l.holds.g053.flags.already_paid).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('a heartbeat under two minutes old, on the PayPal sandbox', () => { pm.expect(a.ageSeconds).to.be.below(120); pm.expect(a.paypal).to.eql('live'); });

item.name: The daily cap on agent runs

exec: pm.test('used never exceeds the limit', () => { pm.expect(b.limit).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(b.used).to.be.at.most(b.limit); });
pm.test('at least one event from PayPal', () => pm.expect(lines.length).to.be.at.least(1));
pm.test('each one verified against the registered webhook', () => lines.forEach((e) => { pm.expect(e.verified, e.id).to.eql(true); pm.expect(e.type).to.match(/^(PAYMENT|INVOICING)\./); }));

item.name: Sam's tap is refused without the treasurer's PIN

exec: pm.test('it asks for the PIN and does nothing', () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.ok).to.eql(false); pm.expect(r.needsPin).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Closing a gym is refused without the treasurer's PIN
The held game is still held
